chatOpening.shortForm.draftChapter.promp: Use the short-form chapter drafting workflow. Read the current project requirements, brief, outline, and character notes first, decide what the next chapter or passage should advance, then draft text that can go directly into the manuscript.

chatOpening.shortForm.goldenThree.prompt: Use the golden-three-chapter planning workflow. Analyze retention, pressure escalation, state changes, and payoff rhythm across the first three chapters, then propose executable beat adjustments.
chatOpening.shortForm.opening.label: Rewrite opening
chatOpening.shortForm.opening.prompt: Use the short-form opening design workflow. Analyze the title promise, genre promise, protagonist pressure, and first-three-paragraph progression, then propose a stronger retention-focused opening.
chatOpening.shortForm.promise.label: Clarify reader promise
chatOpening.shortForm.promise.prompt: Based on the current short-form project, clarify the target reader, core promise, and smallest viable draft direction.
chatOpening.shortForm.revise.label: Diagnose short-form draft
chatOpening.shortForm.revise.prompt: Use the short-form revision workflow. Diagnose the current manuscript or draft for retention, conflict, pacing, payoff, and opening problems; if edits are appropriate, propose scoped revisions.
chatOpening.shortForm.rhythm.label: Review pacing
chatOpening.shortForm.rhythm.prompt: Review the current short-form text for pacing, argument structure, and redundant sections.
chatOpening.shortForm.structure.label: Generate structure
chatOpening.shortForm.structure.prompt: Generate a clear structure for the current short-form project, including opening hook and ending payoff.
chatOpening.shortForm.title: I can help you clarify topic, structure, and draft direction for this short-form project.
chatOpening.sources.collect.label: Collect sources
chatOpening.sources.collect.prompt: Read the available data sources, files, or connected materials for this project, extract the material most relevant to the current task, and note what is missing.
chatOpening.sources.compare.label: Compare material
chatOpening.sources.compare.prompt: Compare the available materials in this project and identify key differences, shared conclusions, and usable evidence.
chatOpening.sources.inspiration.label: Idea hunt
chatOpening.sources.inspiration.prompt: Use [source:wangwen-bigdata] for inspiration exploration. Prioritize past-week newcomer charts, rising themes, hit openings, and recurring character setups. Return 5 practical short-form story directions, each with reader promise, conflict hook, protagonist pressure, opening angle, and differentiation risk.
chatOpening.tools.inspect.label: Inspect project
chatOpening.tools.inspect.prompt: Inspect the current project structure and recent changes, then identify the highest-value next items to handle.
chatOpening.tools.skill.label: Run a skill
chatOpening.tools.skill.prompt: Choose a suitable project skill or writing method for the current goal, explain why, and use that workflow to take the first step.
chatOpening.tools.tutorial.label: Quick tutorial
chatOpening.tools.tutorial.prompt: I want to get started with Storyflow. Use [skill:.agents:storyflow-tutorial] to ask what I want to accomplish, then teach only the shortest relevant path through chat, Skills, Sources, project files, review, and System Instructions.

A Craft Agent alapértelmezett állapotba való visszaállításához lépj ki az alkalmazásból, majd futtasd:

settings.messaging.lark.instructions:
1. Nyisd meg a Lark Open Platform (lark) vagy Feishu Open Platform (feishu) oldalt, és hozz létre egy Custom App-ot
2. Másold ki az App ID (cli_…) és App Secret értékeket
3. Engedélyezd az im:message + im:message.group_at_msg + im:message:send_as_bot jogosultságokat
4. Iratkozz fel az im.message.receive_v1 eseményre 'long connection' módban
5. Hagyd üresen az Encrypt Key mezőt — a long connection mód nem használ payload-titkosítást
